post.title: $1,000 in the S&P 500 in 1980 became $202,134 by 2025
post.ig:
$1,000 in the S&P 500 in January 1980 became $202,134 by December 2025.

That's with dividends reinvested (S&P total return). Price only: $63,419.
Adjusted for inflation (CPI), $202,134 equals about $47,843 in December 1979 dollars.
The ride included -37.00% in 2008 and -18.11% in 2022. About 12.2% a year, 8.8% after inflation. Past results don't guarantee future ones.

Sources: S&P Dow Jones Indices annual total returns (via Slickcharts); S&P 500 closes 107.94 (Dec 31, 1979) and 6,845.50 (Dec 31, 2025); BLS CPI-U. Ignores fees and taxes.
